tenures.note: The team's own introduction on it is the AAWC ring announcer's: "one of the greatest tag teams of all time, here are Tully Planchard and Ern Enderson, THE CUTTERS!" — they then attacked the CS Express from behind before the bell, using two decoys in Western outfits. This is the team's earliest staging anywhere in the held record, and it is an AAWC one. The cswa tenure is kept FIRST in the array because the shard-assignment rule reads tenures[0] and this row's home wing is the CSWA — the same order battleship-cswa and submarine-cswa already carry for the same card.

notes: The row was filed "type": "character" while being a two-man tag team, and so carried neither unit_kind nor members[]. WHAT THE RECORD STAGES: the pair wrestle as a team on twelve cards in the collection — the AAWC's own of 5 August 1995 and eleven CSWA ones — and the CSWA's own ring announcer names both men as THE CUTTERS. The id is unchanged, so every reference still resolves and no alias is owed. STILL OPEN, and deliberately not touched here: the extraction wired this unit row into two CSWA shows' match sides (SUPERPRIMETIME: I HAVE A DREAM, 15 January 1996; CSWA ANNIVERSARY 1996, 31 March 1996) and the two members individually into nine others, so the same team is sometimes one entity and sometimes two. Making that consistent is a wing-wide convention call, not a fact correction — re-filed to data/review-queue.json as its own row.
